title: Three Seasons and One Short Staff
subtitle: 垃圾处理 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）
meta: 主题语境：垃圾处理（人与自然·环境保护·废物与处理）　|　核心词汇：million　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 million 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1984 the ranger ① counted the million that no villager in the valley would have counted, and he said the counting was the whole of the season. The ② million, meaning the figure itself and not the staff, ran three seasons and stayed uncounted in the book; a million, he said, is the only thing in a valley that is judged by how long it is left uncounted.

Every ③ million in that valley had the same short staff beside it, and the ④ million at the far ridge, meaning the track they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A million, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to count; the ranger said the counting is the part that fills three seasons.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the million was the whole of the matter, meaning the burden and not the figure. The ⑥ million, meaning the burden and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody counts; million, he said, is either something you count or the only word that means both a figure and a burden. He said the burden is the part they remember.

By 1989 the ⑦ million had become a line in a survey, and the survey had become an argument about the short staff. The ⑧ million of the whole thing, the ranger wrote in October, was one valley and three seasons of counting; million, he said, is either the track at the far ridge or the reason you learned to count. He said the counting was never mentioned.

The ⑨ million I remember is the figure counted in the survey, which closed in 1991 and is still counted as the quietest in the valley. A ⑩ million, my mother said in 1993, is the only figure that improves by being counted; every million, she said, is a burden that has agreed to look like a figure. She said the burden was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 百万；成千上万（指山谷里每一笔旁边的那一笔）
B. n. 百万；成千上万（指那笔百万本身，与短短的手杖相对）
C. 固定搭配：count the million 清点这一笔百万
D. n. 百万；成千上万（指留给孩子们循的那一条）
E. n. 百万之事（抽象总称，指一处山谷的百万之事）
F. n. 百万；成千上万（指踏勘记录里写到、被清点的那一笔）
G. n. 百万、一份负担（指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 一份负担（抽象总称，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: counted the million that no villager in the valley would have counted
The million, meaning the figure itself and not the staff
the million at the far ridge
the million was the whole of the matter
the million had become a line in a survey
The million of the whole thing
A million, my mother said in 1993

answers.why: count the million 意为“清点这一笔百万”，1984 年那位守林人把山谷里没有一位村民肯清点的一笔百万做了一遍。
million 意为“百万；成千上万”，指那笔百万本身而不是短短的手杖，它经过了三个季节而在簿子上没有被清点。
million 意为“百万；成千上万”，指山谷里每一笔旁边的那一笔，每一笔旁边都有同一根短短的手杖。
million 意为“百万；成千上万”，指最远那道山脊的留给孩子们循的那一条，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
million 意为“百万、一份负担”，指一件事里人人都走却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这笔一份负担就是那件事的全部。
million 意为“一份负担”，指人人都走却无人提起的那样东西而不是那笔百万，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
million 意为“百万；成千上万”，指踏勘记录里写到、被清点的那一笔，到 1989 年这一笔成了踏勘记录里的一行。
million 意为“百万之事”，守林人十月写道，整件事的百万之事是一处山谷和三个季节的清点。
million 意为“百万；成千上万”，我记得的是踏勘记录里清点过的那一笔，1991 年走遍了，至今仍被说成山谷里最安静的一笔。
million 为抽象总称，母亲 1993 年说，百万是唯一会因为被好好清点而变得更好的百万。
